subject: Proposal: Leveling + Geo Harmonization Pilot (matrix + multipliers)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps Consulting <peopleops-consult@example.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Leveling + Geo Harmonization Pilot (matrix + multipliers)

Team — attaching a concise proposal and the market benchmark packet we commissioned from PeopleOps. TL;DR: recommend we pilot a harmonized approach for IC leveling that uses a single global level matrix + location multipliers for cost predictability, rather than separate country-specific bands.

Why now:
- Rapid growth: +40% headcount expected across Eng + Product in next 12 months; inconsistent geo bands are increasing offer churn.
- Complexity: current per-country bands create 30% variation in offer strategy and slow approvals.
- Market signals: Q2 benchmarks show open-source infra engineers in EU markets are ~10–12% behind US West medians; APAC tilt varies by city.

Proposal overview (see comp-band-proposal-v3.xlsx):
1) Single leveling matrix (L1–L7) with role anchors (IC/Staff/Principal).
2) Location multiplier table (region buckets: US core, US remote, EU, APAC major, APAC secondary) applied to base midpoint.
3) Pilot cohort: 18 reqs (Engineering ICs across US West, EU-remote, Bengaluru candidates) for 8 weeks to validate hire velocity and offer acceptance rates.
4) Budget impact: estimate +6.5% net comp delta in year 1 for new hires; headcount ask unchanged.

Requests / asks:
- Vivek: decision on whether to greenlight the pilot (we'll need exec sponsorship).
- Laura: quick sanity check on FY26 hiring budget and compensatory levers (bonuses, equity pool).
- Monica: ops to prepare communications for hiring managers and updated offer templates.
- Aditya: confirm sourcing plan with CloudHire (external) and review benchmark questions.

PeopleOps also included the raw market slabs (market-benchmarks-2026-q2.pdf) and simulations (pilot-simulations.csv). I kept the sheet to 2 pages so the leadership read is fast.

Thanks — if we can sync Wed AM for 30m I can walk the numbers.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Head of People Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Leveling + Geo Harmonization Pilot (matrix + multipliers)

Irene — thanks for the clear packet. A few quick thoughts after skimming: 
1) Simulations: can you add an offer acceptance sensitivity where equity grant slices move +/– 15%? Our Dedicated hiring tends to be equity-heavier.
2) Risk: how do we handle candidates in high-cost US markets (NYC/SF) when we apply a single midpoint + multiplier? There should be hard caps so hiring managers don't over-index.
3) SLA: recommend pilot include time-to-offer and average offer delta tracked by region.

If we proceed I'd like to present to Exec Ops on Friday for formal sign-off. Can you prepare a 1-slide summary with three go/no-go bullets (budget, speed, experience) and the recommended exec sponsor?

Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Proposal: Leveling + Geo Harmonization Pilot (matrix + multipliers)

Folks — quick finance take after a day with the spreadsheet: 
- Headcount: no change to req counts; funding cadence looks OK under current FY26 hiring profile.
- Net comp delta: I see the +6.5% (conservative). Recommend we fund the delta from the recruiting ramp reserve for Q3; that'll avoid re-running comp plans mid-year.
- Equity: we can flex the grant size in the offer engine for the pilot; please flag roles where equity must be protected (hard constraints).

Irene — will join the Exec Ops review if you can provide the 1-slide and a brief matrix showing funding sources for the delta.

Laura
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: PeopleOps Consulting <peopleops-consult@example.com>

Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Leveling + Geo Harmonization Pilot (matrix + multipliers)

Thanks for looping us in. A few benchmarking notes from our side: 
- Our Q2 data (attached) shows US West median for Senior IC infra ~$210k total comp; EU remote equivalent median ~€145k. Applying a flat multiplier underweights candidate expectations in Germany/Netherlands — suggest introducing an EU+ premium band for critical roles.
- APAC: city-level granularity matters. Bengaluru vs. Singapore vs. Sydney show material differences; our recommended pilot bucket uses APAC major (Singapore/Sydney) vs APAC secondary (Bengaluru/remote).
- Candidate experience: unified banding is fine if offers include a short explanation for candidates; transparency reduces negotiation steps.

We also ran the acceptance sensitivity you requested (equity +/-15%) — results attached in pilot-simulations.csv. Equity moves materially in Senior hires; for L5–L6 it shifts acceptance by 6–9%.

Happy to join the Exec Ops sync and present the benchmark caveats.

— PeopleOps team
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

- Exec Ops on Friday 08:30 PT: I will present the 1-slide with three decision points (approve pilot, approve funding source, approve exec sponsor). Vivek to present sponsor recommendation.
- Pilot scope trimmed to 12 reqs (removed two fringe roles and two high-variance APAC positions) to reduce FY26 delta to ~+4.2%. Updated spreadsheet attached.
- Monica: please draft the manager FAQ and a short candidate-facing note phrased in plain language to explain multipliers.
- Aditya: confirm CloudHire can prioritize the 12 reqs and share baseline pipeline estimates by EOD Monday.

If no objections by EOD Thurs I will lock the deck for Exec Ops. Appreciate the quick turn.

— Irene
